scope: per-job provenance for the local ORCA jobs registered by the WP1 method audit and the WP2 production segment; raw outputs stay outside the repository
evidence_digest_recipe:
sha256 over the sorted `
`-joined lines `<file_sha256>  <repo-relative path>` for every hashed input / start geometry / final geometry / raw output; recompute this after extracting an independent archive
archive_policy: raw ORCA logs are not mirrored; the manifest records repository-relative logical locations plus sha256 so an independent archive can be verified

checks.description: 每个已结束（computed / failed）的作业都有原始 ORCA 输出及其 sha256
没有原始输出的作业（在跑 / 崩溃残骸）显式标注 job_state，不冒充证据
每个作业的方法回显取自它自己的 .inp，而不是外部声明
正常结束标志从 .log 的 ORCA TERMINATED NORMALLY 读回
每个派生数值都能映射回一个作业 ID（job_matrix / production_ledger）
清单里的路径是仓库相对形状，可移植
